newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Chrysler to open warehouse centre in Taiwan.
newsitem.headline: Chrysler to open warehouse centre in Taiwan.

text.p: U.S. car maker Chrysler Corp will set up a warehousing centre in Taiwan's central Taichung Harbour and has plans to import one million cars into the island within 20 years, the Taichung Harbour Bureau said on Monday.

Chrysler, through its local agent, on Monday signed contracts with the bureau, promising to import a minimum of 16,752 cars a year into the island and a total of one million cars within 20 years, the bureau said in a statement.
Chrysler's agent will invest T$142 million to set up the warehousing centre, the statement said.
"We estimate the move can increase the harbour's income by more than T$21 million a year, and bring...our country an annual tariff income of more than T$3.2 billion," it said.
The statement gave no further details about the deal.
Taiwan imposes tariffs of 30 percent on imported passenger cars.
In recent years, Taiwan has offered various incentives to lure international companies to set up their regional operation centres on the island.
